articles.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
articles.snippet: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.

articles.title: AI Music Company Suno Loses Copyright Case in Germany
articles.snippet: The decision requires AI companies to license copyrighted music used to train models and generate songs, marking another legal win for music rights holders in Europe.

articles.title: Circle Lands New York Trust Charter as Stablecoin Issuer Expands Regulatory Footprint
articles.snippet: The approval comes weeks after Circle won federal approval to establish a national trust bank, adding another license as the USDC issuer expands.

articles.title: Your 'Sexual Wellness' Pills Order Info From Hims Got Shared With Meta, Says FTC
articles.snippet: Regulators accuse the telehealth company of sharing sensitive health information with advertising platforms including Meta and Snap despite promising users privacy.
